title: Editorial contents and statement spreads
slide_intent: Separate navigation, introduction and sustained reading, because readers need different entry points into a long document.
strategic_value: A repeated small 4 and disciplined columns can keep Channel 4 recognizable while making formal information accessible.
demonstration: Two white editorial spreads sit side by side on black: a contents spread pairs a gradient image with numbered entries, while a statement spread pairs a large heading with narrow text columns.
practical_value: Compare how a contents page and a long statement reuse the same margins while changing text density.

content_islands.name: Contents spread
content_islands.spec: Place a gradient image on the left page and a numbered contents list on the right.

content_islands.name: Statement spread
content_islands.spec: Start the next spread with a small 4 and large heading, then carry the statement through narrow columns on the right.

content_islands.name: Comparison field
content_islands.spec: Align both spreads on a black ground so their whitespace and column structures can be compared.

reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram’s accompanying case study says the typography and layout principles use a clear information hierarchy to balance the eclectic content, color and motion.

reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in contents and statement spreads.
